title: Samsung WF6000R — Smart Install entry
description: Enter Smart Install (AS) for automatic/manual component checks and diagnostic code display.

steps.title: Standby — empty drum
steps.body: Washer standby. Drum empty. Set scheduled time to 17:00 for Smart Install path per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Washer standby. Drum empty. Set scheduled time to 17:00 for Smart Install path per manual.

steps.title: Enter Smart Install
steps.body: Press Start/Pause for 7 seconds after scheduled time setup. Display shows AS when Smart Install is active.
